# Dr. Nihar Modi - Orthopaedic and Sports Surgeon in Bandra & Mumbai

> Dr. Nihar Modi is an Orthopaedic and Sports Surgeon specializing in Sports Medicine, Arthroscopy (Keyhole Surgery), Joint Preservation, and Joint Reconstruction in Bandra West, Khar, Santacruz, and Greater Mumbai.

## About & Brand Identity
- **Name**: Dr. Nihar Modi
- **Brand Identity**: Orthopaedic and Sports Surgeon
- **Practice Focus**: Sports Medicine, Arthroscopic Surgery (Knee, Shoulder, Elbow, Hip), Joint Preservation, Cartilage Restoration, Ligament Reconstruction, and Joint Replacement.
- **Practice Philosophy**: Joint preservation first; surgery is recommended strictly when evidence-based non-operative care (physiotherapy, biological injections, activity modification) is exhausted or when acute structural repair is essential for joint stability.
- **National Medical Commission (NMC) Compliance**: Strictly adheres to the National Medical Commission Registered Medical Practitioner (Professional Conduct) Regulations. All statements and content are evidence-based, factual, non-superlative, and devoid of commercial claims or self-laudatory rankings.
